name: hud_sensor_map_node_free_point_array
description: Frees the stored point array when present without otherwise resetting node fields.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker/map.cpp source-cluster pass.
The smoke exercises successful cleanup through higher-level map-node ownership paths; it does not use allocator instrumentation to prove no-op behavior for a null point pointer.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x415ac0 loads the point-array pointer, calls free only when non-null, and returns void; native smokes cover cleanup after loaded nodes and tracker shutdown.
